a: Instrumental percussion only, 76 BPM, 4/4. A soft, steady, slightly suspenseful ticking pulse for a secret vote: a muted woodblock ticking on every beat like a clock, quiet closed hi-hat in eighth notes, a soft wooden shaker, and a very soft low heartbeat-like drum on beats one and three. No pitched instruments, no melody, no chords, no bass, no fills, no build-up, no ending, the same throughout so it can loop seamlessly.
